sections.show: Meet Louis Cagnion, a Tech and Data Engineering apprentice at Groupe Tressol-Chabrier, trained at 42 Perpignan. His mission: from the 42 piscine to artificial intelligence.
sections.say: Meet Louis Kanyon, a Tech and Data Engineering apprentice at Groupe Tressol Shabree-ay, trained at forty-two Perpeenyan. His mission: from the forty-two pee-seen to artificial intelligence.

sections.show: His journey began in 2024 with a first piscine at 42, continued through the common core, and today leads him to Groupe Tressol-Chabrier. Next stop: a level 7 degree in AI, with AI research on the horizon.
sections.say: His journey began in twenty twenty-four with a first pee-seen at forty-two, continued through the common core, and today leads him to Groupe Tressol Shabree-ay. Next stop: a level seven degree in A I, with A I research on the horizon.

sections.show: His skills are grouped in constellations: the larger the celestial body, the stronger his mastery. C is his strongest language.
sections.say: His skills are grouped in constellations: the larger the celestial body, the stronger his mastery. C is his strongest language.

sections.show: Four star systems hold his projects: his work at Tressol-Chabrier, his personal projects, and his school projects from 42 Perpignan and the piscine.
